title: 2022 AMC 10B Problem 1
statement: Define \(x~\diamondsuit~ y\) to be \(|x-y|\) for all real numbers \(x\) and \(y.\) What is the value of \[(1~\diamondsuit~(2~\diamondsuit~3))-((1~\diamondsuit~2)~\diamondsuit~3)?\]

solutions.text:
Working from the innermost operations outward gives \[ \begin{aligned} 1\mathbin\diamondsuit(2\mathbin\diamondsuit3)&=|1-|2-3||=0,\\ (1\mathbin\diamondsuit2)\mathbin\diamondsuit3&=||1-2|-3|=2. \end{aligned} \] Therefore, the given difference is \(0-2=-2.\)

Thus, the answer is A .
hints: Remember that the operation is absolute difference
Evaluate each diamond operation from the inside out
